## Articles
- [Sneaker releases this week: October 27 to 31, 2026](https://restockrally.com/news/sneaker-releases-october-27-31-2026/): The Air Jordan 3 Fireside, Kobe Mamba Eterno pack, Air Jordan 14 Forest Green and more land between October 27 and 31.
- [Air Jordan 6 "White Infrared" returns November 7 for $215](https://restockrally.com/news/air-jordan-6-white-infrared-november-7-2026/): Nike's SNKRS page lists the Air Jordan 6 White Infrared, style code CT8529-105, for November 7 at $215.
- [Air Jordan 11 "Green Screen" set for November 14 at $255](https://restockrally.com/news/air-jordan-11-green-screen-november-14-2026/): Nike lists the Air Jordan 11 Green Screen, inspired by Space Jam's green screens, for November 14 at $255.
- [Nike LeBron XXIV "Stars" debuts November 17 for $180](https://restockrally.com/news/nike-lebron-xxiv-stars-november-17-2026/): Nike says the LeBron XXIV is the lightest LeBron signature shoe yet. The Stars colorway arrives November 17 for $180.
- [October restocks: Nike Mind, Air Bakin and Air Max Phenomena came back](https://restockrally.com/news/october-2026-sneaker-restocks-nike-mind-air-bakin/): Nike Mind 001 and 002, the Air Bakin High SP and the Air Max Phenomena all restocked in October 2026. Here is what came back and where.
